The Role:

Generate Biomedicines is seeking a principal engineer to lead the evolution of our scientific data and analytical tools. Experimental data is central to how we design, evaluate, and improve protein therapeutics. Making that data accessible, interpretable, and trustworthy is essential to connecting laboratory experimentation with computational design and scientific decision-making.

In this role, you will set the technical direction and deliver systems that connect agents with experimental data, reproducible processing, quality-controlled results, and analysis across experiments. You will help scientists move beyond traditional workflows toward an integrated agentic experience where they can ask questions, explore evidence, and make informed decisions.

You will build on Generate's agent platform, connecting agents with internal tools, data, and scientific workflows. Working closely with experimental scientists, Data Science, laboratory systems engineers, and the platform team, you will translate scientific needs into a clear roadmap and powerful software. This is a hands-on technical leadership role with responsibility for architecture, implementation, and adoption.

Location:

This role is based in Somerville, MA, with an expectation of working onsite at least three days per week.

Here's how you will contribute:

• Define and deliver the scientific data and analytics roadmap. Understand how scientists work today, identify the highest-value opportunities, and turn a broad vision into focused capabilities that improve experimental analysis and decision-making.

• Connect the experimental data lifecycle. Design data models, interfaces, and workflows that link raw instrument outputs to samples, experimental conditions, processing methods, QC decisions, and published results. Partner with laboratory systems engineers to establish reliable handoffs from data capture into processing and analysis.

• Build reproducible processing and trustworthy results. Work closely with Data Science and assay experts to define and implement mathematical methods, statistical analyses, normalization, and QC rules. Support versioned processing, traceable results, and controlled recomputation as methods evolve.

• Create agentic analytical experiences. Build agent-accessible tools and applications that help scientists retrieve data, inspect processing, visualize results, compare experiments, and explore hypotheses. Combine agent flexibility with validated computational methods and appropriate scientific review.

• Enable meaningful analysis across experiments. Address differences in assay versions, units, experimental conditions, controls, and sample identity so scientists and computational teams can make defensible comparisons and reuse data.

• Lead through implementation and collaboration. Make architectural decisions, build systems, guide engineering contributors, and resolve difficult integration problems. Partner with scientists and program teams to establish requirements, evaluate outputs, and drive adoption.

• Own measurable outcomes. Assess success through reliable processing, scientific validity, time saved, and sustained use. Establish practical monitoring and feedback mechanisms, and improve workflows based on real scientific work.

The Ideal Candidate will have:

• A bachelor's or advanced degree in computer science, engineering, bioinformatics, a quantitative scientific discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

• Substantial experience designing and delivering scientific software or data systems, with demonstrated technical leadership across architecture, implementation, and deployment.

• Strong hands-on agentic programming skills, including Python, and experience building data-processing pipelines, APIs, and analytical applications.

• Experience developing or integrating AI agents, with sound judgment about their appropriate use, evaluation, and interaction with deterministic processing.

• Experience modeling experimental data, including metadata, provenance, versioning, and data quality. Ability to balance consistent structures with the diversity of scientific workflows.

• Strong grounding in mathematics, statistics, and experimental analysis to collaborate deeply with data scientists and assay experts and translate their methods into reliable software.

• A track record of turning ambiguous scientific needs into a clear technical direction, prioritized deliverables, and software that people use.

• Strong collaborative skills and the ability to communicate effectively with experimental scientists, data scientists, software engineers, and scientific leaders.

#LI-HM1

About Generate Biomedicines

We are a clinical-stage generative biology company pioneering the AI revolution in drug design and development. We are advancing a new approach to drug creation—one grounded in the ability to design proteins with defined biological intent. By integrating machine learning with large-scale experimentation, this approach aims to reduce the uncertainty, time, and cost associated with developing protein-based medicines.

Founded in 2018, we are advancing a growing pipeline of clinical and preclinical programs across multiple disease areas and protein modalities. By unifying computational design and clinical development within a single operating model, we translate this approach into clinical-stage programs and are leading a shift from traditional drug discovery toward systematic drug generation.

At Generate:Biomedicines, we collaborate across disciplines in new ways to invent and innovate. We bring diverse perspectives to a shared goal of delivering better medicines to patients in need, faster, guided by our values and leadership behaviors.

Generate:Biomedicines is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

Any resume submitted by an agency in the absence of a signed agreement will automatically become the property of Generate:Biomedicines and the Company will not owe any referral or other fees with respect thereto.

About Maneva

Maneva is building the Thinking Factory: a factory floor that sees, understands, and acts on its own. Our Vision-to-Action AI turns video from off-the-shelf cameras into real-time decisions, with no rip-and-replace of existing infrastructure. We work with mid-market and enterprise manufacturers to deliver end-to-end outcomes, not dashboards:

• Higher yields: catch defects and process drift as they happen, and cut scrap and downtime.

• Closed-loop integration: connect vision insights directly to MES, PLC, and other production systems so findings trigger action.

• Safer, compliant floors: detect safety and compliance risks continuously, instead of relying on periodic audits.

Founded in 2022, Maneva raised a $27M Series A led by U.S. Venture Partners in June 2026 to push the frontier of our vision models, expand factory orchestration, and bring Thinking Factories to new industries and geographies. The models you build here will run on real production lines, where accuracy, latency, and reliability decide outcomes.

What you'll do

• Define the technical strategy and architecture for vision models across detection, VLM, and VLA workloads.

• Train, fine-tune, and adapt models (YOLO variants, open VLMs, VLA policies) on proprietary data, including distillation, quantization, and LoRA-style adaptation.

• Build data engines: labeling pipelines, auto-labeling with foundation models, active learning, and synthetic or simulated data.

• Design rigorous evaluation: benchmarks, regression suites, failure-mode analysis, and online metrics tied to product outcomes.

• Ship models to production under latency, memory, and cost limits, on cloud GPUs and edge hardware (TensorRT, ONNX, Jetson or similar).

• Lead cross-team technical projects; write design docs; review code and models; mentor senior and mid-level engineers.

• Track the research frontier, decide what is worth adopting, and turn it into prototypes and product.

Requirements

What we're looking for

• 5+ years building and shipping ML systems, with focus on computer vision; BS/MS/PhD in CS, EE, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

• Deep hands-on experience with object detection and segmentation (YOLO family, DETR-style models), including training, tuning, and production deployment.

• Hands-on experience with VLMs (for example LLaVA-, Qwen-VL-, or PaliGemma-style models): fine-tuning, prompting, grounding, and evaluation.

• Experience with VLAs or embodied and robot-learning models (for example OpenVLA-, RT-2-, or pi0-style policies), or a clear record in adjacent multimodal work.

• Strong PyTorch skills and fluency with distributed training, mixed precision, and GPU profiling.

• Track record of taking models from research to production: model optimization, inference serving, monitoring, and iteration on real-world failures.

• Evidence of staff-level impact: setting direction across teams, making sound build-versus-adopt calls, and raising the bar for others.

• Clear written and verbal communication with engineers, researchers, and product leaders.

Nice to have

• Publications or open-source contributions in vision or multimodal learning.

• Experience with video understanding, 3D perception, or multi-sensor fusion.

• Experience with simulation, sim-to-real transfer, or reinforcement and imitation learning.

• Edge and embedded deployment experience (TensorRT, CUDA, quantization-aware training).

• Experience with LLM tooling such as vLLM, or with RLHF-style post-training for multimodal models.

• This role may support work subject to U.S. export controls. Access to certain projects may require U.S.-person status (U.S. citizen or national, lawful permanent resident, refugee, or asylee) or export authorization.

Benefits

Why Join Maneva?

• Drive operational excellence in a fast-growing AI company transforming manufacturing through cutting-edge vision systems

• Shape the future of project delivery by building scalable processes for AI system deployments

• Work with world-class engineering talent while optimizing team performance and customer success

• Gain exposure to cutting-edge Vision AI & IoT solutions across diverse manufacturing environments

• Lead strategic initiatives that directly impact company growth and customer satisfaction

• Build expertise in the rapidly expanding field of industrial AI and autonomous manufacturing

Compensation & Benefits

• Salary based on location and experience - market rate

• Equity participation in a high-growth AI startup

• Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage

• Flexible PTO and professional development opportunities

• Remote-first culture with modern collaboration tools

Important Notice: Protecting Your Personal Information

We are committed to ensuring the security and privacy of all applicants. Please be aware that our company will never ask for sensitive personal information, via email, phone call or text message. We also do not require payment from applicants for any part of the hiring process.

If you are contacted by someone claiming to represent our company and asking for such information, please do not respond. Instead, report the incident to us immediately at IT-Security@Maneva.ai.

Roku is changing how the world watches TV

Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

About the role

Roku is seeking a Senior AI Transformation Engineer to join the AI Enablement Team and drive end-to-end delivery of agentic AI systems that measurably transform how work gets done across Roku. In this role, you will embed directly with business and technical teams—including Legal, FP&A, Accounting, Brand, Customer Support, and Engineering—to identify the highest-value opportunities for AI-powered automation and deliver production-grade solutions. You will own the full lifecycle from opportunity identification and scoping through system design, build, deployment, and adoption, operating as a self-directed contributor who thrives in ambiguity and can navigate complex organizational dynamics. This is a hands-on builder role that requires strong software engineering fundamentals, deep AI expertise, and a product-oriented mindset focused on adoption and measurable business impact, not demos. You will go beyond point solutions to reimagine how entire functions operate as AI-native, agent-powered systems, and you will codify reusable patterns back into Roku's broader AI platform strategy. The ideal candidate brings technical depth, cross-functional collaboration skills, and the ability to drive change management that ensures the solutions you build are trusted and actively used.

For Massachusetts Only - The estimated annual base salary for this position is between $242,200 and $486,000. Compensation packages are based on factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, certifications, and specific geographical location. This role is eligible for health insurance, equity awards, life insurance, disability benefits, parental leave, wellness benefits, and paid time off.

How will I use AI at Roku?

At Roku, we don't just use AI; we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We're looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they've used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact.

We value your AI skills if you have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you.

What are the responsibilities of the role?

• p]:inline">Drive AI deployments from discovery and scoping through system design, build, and production rollout, owning the outcome end to end

• p]:inline">Embed directly with business and technical teams to diagnose real problems, often before they are clearly articulated, and identify the highest-value opportunities for agentic automation

• p]:inline">Prepare clear scopes of work and pragmatic project plans for both prototypes and full production deployments, making real-time trade-offs on scope, priority, and quality

• p]:inline">Design, build, test, and deploy production-grade agentic AI applications and integrations, moving from prototype to live system in short cycles

• p]:inline">Reimagine how entire functions operate as AI-native, agent-powered systems, going beyond individual task automation

• p]:inline">Connect solutions to Roku's data platforms, internal systems, and enterprise APIs, working across complex and disparate data sources, pipelines, and metric layers

• p]:inline">Lead onboarding, enablement, and change management for the teams you serve, iterating on real user feedback until solutions are trusted and actively used

• p]:inline">Define and track success through production adoption, workflow impact, and measurable business value

• p]:inline">Collaborate with embedded AI Ambassadors, mentor teammates, and flex across functions, domains, and initiatives as priorities evolve

• p]:inline">Codify reusable patterns and field learnings back into Roku's broader AI platform strategy to strengthen shared capabilities and frameworks

We're Excited If You Have

• p]:inline">5+ years of software engineering, full-stack engineering, or technical deployment experience with a track record of shipping production systems

• p]:inline">Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

• p]:inline">Strong software engineering fundamentals with the ability to write and ship production-grade code (e.g., Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript)

• p]:inline">Hands-on experience building or deploying systems powered by LLMs, generative models, or agentic frameworks

• p]:inline">Demonstrated ability to thrive in ambiguity, decomposing open-ended problems into workstreams and making sound trade-offs under pressure

• p]:inline">Proven experience working directly with non-technical teams and stakeholders, translating business needs into technical solutions and communicating clearly to executive audiences

• p]:inline">A track record of building solutions that achieve adoption and measurable impact

• p]:inline">Strong product sense and a bias toward outcomes over output

• p]:inline">High autonomy and ownership with the ability to drive decisions and deliver independently in fast-moving environments

• p]:inline">Experience with modern AI engineering patterns such as RAG, prompt engineering, agent orchestration, tool-use, human-in-the-loop controls, model evaluation, and MLOps/LLMOps

• p]:inline">Experience with modern data architectures and relational databases

What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?

Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.

What are some of the benefits?

Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.

Accommodations

Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com.

What should I know about Roku's culture?

Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. 

We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002. 

To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet.

jobs.job_title: Principal AI Engineer - Agentic Solutions & Delivery
jobs.job_description:
Additional Location(s): US-MA-Marlborough; US-MN-Arden Hills

Diversity - Innovation - Caring - Global Collaboration - Winning Spirit - High Performance

At Boston Scientific, we’ll give you the opportunity to harness all that’s within you by working in teams of diverse and high-performing employees, tackling some of the most important health industry challenges. With access to the latest tools, information and training, we’ll help you in advancing your skills and career. Here, you’ll be supported in progressing – whatever your ambitions.

About this role:

Boston Scientific was recognized by Forbes as one of the Best Workplaces for Engineers in 2026, reflecting a culture where engineers do meaningful work.

Boston Scientific was recognized as a Glassdoor Best Place to Work in 2026, ranking No. 15 on the Top 100 list, reflecting the culture our employees experience every day.

As a Principal AI Engineer- Agentic Solutions & Delivery within Boston Scientific's AI Platform & Engineering team, you will serve as a hands on technical leader responsible for designing, developing and delivering enterprise artificial intelligence (AI) solutions that transform high-value business workflows. You will leverage Boston Scientific's enterprise Agent Mesh architecture, generative AI technologies and modern full-stack engineering practices to build intelligent, scalable, production-ready applications that integrate AI agents with enterprise systems and business processes.

This role requires a strong builder mindset, deep software engineering expertise and the ability to collaborate directly with business stakeholders to translate complex challenges into practical AI solutions. You will lead technical implementations from proof of concept through production deployment and enterprise scale, helping accelerate AI innovation and deliver measurable business impact.

Work model, sponsorship, relocation:

At Boston Scientific, we value collaboration and synergy. This role follows a hybrid work model requiring employees to be in our local office at least three days per week. Boston Scientific will not offer sponsorship or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for this position at this time. Relocation assistance is not available for this position at this time.

Your responsibilities will include:
• Lead the hands-on design and development of complex, production-grade agentic AI applications using AWS Bedrock, Bedrock AgentCore and enterprise AI frameworks.
• Design and implement multi-agent workflows, orchestration logic, AI tools and enterprise integrations using Model Context Protocol (MCP), application programming interfaces (APIs) and approved Agent Mesh patterns.
• Develop full-stack AI applications using Python, TypeScript, modern front-end frameworks and cloud-native back-end services.
• Partner directly with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams to translate high-value business workflows into scalable, AI-powered solutions.
• Drive end-to-end technical delivery of AI implementations, from rapid prototyping and proof of concept through minimum viable product (MVP) development, production deployment and ongoing enhancement.
• Build secure integrations with enterprise platforms, data sources and business applications, ensuring reliable access to governed enterprise capabilities.
• Implement AI application testing, evaluation, observability, security and reliability controls to ensure production readiness and performance.
• Establish reusable engineering patterns, agent components, MCP tools and application frameworks to accelerate AI solution delivery across the enterprise.
• Resolve complex technical challenges, evaluate architectural trade-offs and provide hands-on technical leadership and mentorship to engineering teams.

Required qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, computer engineering or a related technical field.
• Minimum of 10 years' experience in professional software engineering, including significant hands-on development and technical leadership.
• Strong proficiency in Python, with experience building production-grade back-end services, APIs and distributed applications.
• Strong proficiency in TypeScript and JavaScript, with experience developing modern web applications using React or comparable frameworks.
• Hands-on experience developing generative AI applications using large language models (LLMs), agentic AI frameworks, tool calling and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
• Experience designing and implementing enterprise integrations, REST APIs, cloud-native applications and distributed systems.
• Strong experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS) or equivalent cloud platforms, modern software development practices, automated testing and continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD).
• Demonstrated ability to independently architect, build, troubleshoot and deliver complex software solutions from concept through production.

Preferred qualifications:
• Hands-on experience with AWS Bedrock, Bedrock AgentCore, LangGraph or comparable agent orchestration technologies.
• Experience developing MCP servers, clients, tools and multi-agent integration patterns.
• Experience integrating AI applications with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, Snowflake, SAP or Azure AI services.
• Familiarity with graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (Graph-RAG), knowledge graphs, vector databases, semantic search and enterprise data retrieval patterns.
• Experience implementing LLM evaluations, distributed tracing, OpenTelemetry and AI application observability.
• Strong understanding of enterprise identity, authentication, authorization and secure AI application development.
• Demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguous business and technical challenges, rapidly prototype solutions and deliver measurable business outcomes.
• Proven ability to lead complex technical implementations, mentor engineers and influence architecture and engineering decisions across cross-functional teams.
• Experience developing production software in health care, medical devices, life sciences or other regulated enterprise environments.

jobs.job_description: Firm Overview: Cambridge Associates (“CA”) is a leading global investment firm. CA’s goal is to help endowments & foundations, pension plans, and ultra-high net worth private clients implement and manage custom investment portfolios that generate outperformance so that they can maximize their impact on the world. Cambridge Associates delivers a range of services, including outsourced CIO, non-discretionary portfolio management, and investment consulting. Headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, CA has offices in key markets in North America, the United Kingdom, Europe, Asia, and Oceania. Our worldwide teams ensure our clients benefit from decades of global presence, local expertise, and relationships with the top global investment managers across the world. For more information, please visit www.cambridgeassociates.com. The role combines hands-on technical work with leadership of agreed projects and workstreams, mentoring of junior colleagues, and collaboration across investment, business, and technology teams. Working within priorities and scope established with IS leadership, the role applies technical judgment to project delivery, quality, and improvement. Apply statistical and machine-learning methods to moderate-to-complex investment and business problems. jobs.job_title: AI Engineer / Data Scientist, AI Director
jobs.job_description:
The Opportunity
As part of the AI Engineering team within the Digital Assurance & Technology team, you will lead the design and delivery of AI and machine learning solutions that transform data into actionable insights and support client decision-making within our Assurance practice. You will establish portfolio-wide direction and quality expectations for testing and evaluation of AI-enabled systems, technical evidence, and control effectiveness, and sponsor reusable capabilities that support responsible, reliable AI deployment across client engagements. As a Director you will set strategic direction, guide business development, oversee multiple workstreams, and shape client relationships while mentoring leaders and encouraging thoughtful use of new ideas, technology, and practical problem solving. In this role at PwC, you will combine data engineering, AI model development, software implementation, and stakeholder communication to help design scalable solutions, validate technical approaches, and support delivery across complex client environments.
Responsibilities
- Translating business goals into AI and data engineering solutions for client engagements
- Leading the design and deployment of machine learning models, data pipelines, and scalable AI platforms
- Setting portfolio-wide evaluation strategy and quality standards for AI-system behavior, performance, robustness, bias, explainability, and failure modes
- Establishing review standards for technical controls and evidence, confirming that findings, limitations, and recommendations are clear and defensible
- Sponsoring reusable evaluation tools, automated testing, reference datasets, monitoring capabilities, and evidence workflows across engagements
- Guiding data wrangling, feature development, model training, and performance tuning across multiple use cases
- Evaluating data quality, model outputs, and platform integration points to support reliable solution delivery
- Advising clients on AI strategy, use case prioritization, and technology choices aligned to business needs
- Developing new ideas and technical approaches that advance AI capability across teams and engagements
- Coaching practitioners on AI implementation methods, analytical problem solving, and modern development practices
- Identifying opportunities to expand AI offerings and strengthen client relationships through credible delivery
- Adhering to firm technical standards, independence requirements, and professional conduct expectations
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 8 years of experience
What Sets You Apart
- Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Analytics/Data Science, Artificial Intelligence/Robotics, Computer Science/Information Systems, Engineering
- Demonstrating director-level AI and data strategy across client engagements
- Establishing rigorous AI evaluation standards covering failure modes, bias, drift, hallucinations, explainability, and guardrails
- Setting enterprise architecture trade-offs and portfolio-level methods to measure and communicate technical and business outcomes
- Leading business growth through emerging technology solution development
- Developing thought leadership and executive-level client relationships
- Translating complex data concepts into business-focused recommendations
- Navigating ambiguity while guiding multi-disciplinary delivery teams

Inrupt in Boston seeks a Staff Product Engineer / Product Lead to drive AI-native product strategy for the Enterprise Solid Server and Wallets. You will lead a lean team to define roadmaps, prioritize features, and accelerate innovative capabilities at the intersection of data sovereignty and enterprise needs.

This role emphasizes AI tooling adoption, rapid prototyping, and compliance mapping, with a focus on partnerships across engineering, research, and business development to scale adoption

Qualifications
• 5-7+ years of product management or software engineering experience in data infrastructure, privacy tech, or developer platforms.
• Experience with AI/ML tools in product development.
• Proven ability to work in mission-driven, technically complex environments.
• Ability to translate technical specs into business value propositions.

Responsibilities
• Actively maintain a view of how the market, competition and technologies are evolving, factor this and customer feedback into our product direction
• Prioritize features that accelerate Inrupt Enterprise Solid Server and Data and Agentic Wallet adoption and interoperability for enterprises and government entities
• Define and maintain the product roadmap for applications and infrastructure
• Create data-driven business cases for new solutions across verticals (healthcare, government, retail, financial services)

• Implement automated compliance mapping for privacy regulations
• Create AI-assisted migration tools for organizations transitioning from centralized to ESS-based architectures
• Lead the growth of the Product organization
• Foster collaboration between Inrupt's engineering, research, and business development teams
